data_fields.name: window_swap_modifier_change
data_fields.donor_constant: added to the allowance by modifiers (0 by default)

best_idea: A small counted redraw budget in two windows: up to two offered options can be rerolled once before the first turn, and one swap is allowed per turn in the fight, with the replaced option going back to the pool and no same-base-id swap when another option exists.
decision_why: Frankendom has no hand or draw pile, so the shape moves to pre-fight loadout offers (reroll up to two of five offered techniques once before the bout, one reroll per window during it). The budget, the once-per-fight opening flag and the return-to-pool rule are the transferable parts. Duplicate slots are refused in the sketch, which the donor does not do.
acceptance: A server test shows five offered techniques before the bout; a two-slot reroll is accepted once, a three-slot reroll and a second opening reroll are refused; in the bout one swap per window is accepted and a second in the same window is refused; the swapped-in option never shares a base id with the swapped-out one when another option exists.
